title: Bounding Curvature Measure on Manifolds with Singularities
summary: Let $X$ be an $n$-dimensional Alexandrov space with curvature $\ge -1$, and let $η> 0$. Define $\mathcal{S}^{k}_η(X)$ as the set of $(k,η)$-singular points in $X$ whose tangent cones are $η$-away from splitting off $\mathbb{R}^{k+1}$ isometrically. For a point $p \in X$, assume that $M = B_2(p) \setminus (\mathcal{S}^{n-2}_η(X) \cup \partial X)$ is a smooth manifold equipped with the Riemannian metric induced by $X$.
